patient_name.description: What is the full name of the patient

patient_id.description: What is the patient medical record or ID number

date_of_birth.description: What is the patient date of birth

start_time.description: What time did the surgery begin

end_time.description: What time did the surgery end

primary_surgeon.description: Who is the primary operating surgeon

crna.description: Who is the certified registered nurse anesthetist

procedure_name.description: What is the name of the surgical procedure performed

procedure_type.description: Was the procedure elective, urgent, or emergent

approach.description: What surgical approach was used such as open laparoscopic or robotic

laterality.description: What side of the body was the procedure performed on

primary_diagnosis.description: What is the diagnosis or indication that prompted the surgery

secondary_procedure.description: Were any additional procedures performed during the same operation (YES/NO)

patient_positioning.description: How was the patient positioned on the operating table

positioning_aids.description: What padding rolls or devices were used to support patient positioning

safety_strap_applied.description: Was a safety strap applied to the patient (YES/NO)

grounding_pad_placed.description: Was an electrosurgical grounding pad placed (YES/NO)

grounding_pad_location.description: Where was the grounding pad placed

pre_op_skin_prep_solution.description: What antiseptic solution was used to prepare the surgical site

pre_op_skin_prep_area.description: What body area was prepped for surgery

draping.description: How was the surgical field draped

timeout_performed.description: Was a surgical timeout performed before incision (YES/NO)

timeout_verified.description: What was confirmed during the surgical timeout

antibiotic_prophylaxis_agent.description: What prophylactic antibiotic was given before incision

antibiotic_prophylaxis_time.description: What time was the prophylactic antibiotic administered

dvt_prophylaxis.description: What deep vein thrombosis prophylaxis measures were applied

incision_location.description: What anatomical location was the skin incision made

incision_type.description: What type of incision was made such as midline pfannenstiel or trocar

findings.description: What abnormal or notable conditions were discovered during surgery

complications.description: What unplanned adverse events occurred during the procedure

complication_management.description: How were any intraoperative complications managed

estimated_blood_loss.description: What was the estimated volume of blood lost during surgery

urine_output.description: What was the volume of urine output measured during surgery

fluid_in.description: What was the total volume and type of intravenous fluids administered

drain_type.description: What type of drain was placed

tourniquet_inflation_time.description: What was the tourniquet inflation time

tourniquet_pressure.description: What was the tourniquet inflation pressure

electrosurgery_type.description: What electrosurgical devices were used such as bovie or harmonic

intra_op_handoff.description: Were there any changes in surgical or anesthesia personnel during the procedure (YES/NO)

intra_op_imaging.description: Was any imaging used during surgery (YES/NO)

intra_op_imaging_type.description: What imaging was used during surgery

anesthesia_type.description: What type of anesthesia was used such as general spinal or local

intra_op_medications.description: What drugs were administered to the patient during surgery

local_anesthetic_agent.description: What local anesthetic agent was used

local_anesthetic_site.description: At what anatomical site was the local anesthetic injected

transfusion_given.description: Did the patient receive a blood transfusion (YES/NO)

transfusion_volume.description: What volume of blood product was transfused

implants.description: What devices or materials were permanently placed inside the patient

implant_manufacturer.description: What is the manufacturer of the implanted device

implant_lot_number.description: What is the lot number of the implanted device

instruments.description: What surgical instruments or tools were used during the procedure

sponge_count_correct.description: Was the final sponge count correct (YES/NO)

instrument_count_correct.description: Was the final instrument count correct (YES/NO)

sharps_count_correct.description: Was the final sharps count correct (YES/NO)

specimen_removed.description: Was any body tissue or parts removed from the patient (YES/NO)

specimen_description.description: What tissue or body part was removed

specimen_sent_to_pathology.description: Was any specimen sent to pathology for examination (YES/NO)

specimen_label_verified.description: Was the specimen label verified before sending (YES/NO)

specimen_laterality.description: What side of the body was the specimen taken from

closure_method.description: What suture type and technique was used to close the incision

closure_layers.description: What tissue layers were closed such as fascia subcutaneous and skin

post_op_skin_care.description: What dressings or adhesives were applied to the closed incision

wound_classification.description: What wound classification was assigned such as clean or contaminated

patient_condition.description: What was the patient condition at the end of the procedure

extubated_in_or.description: Was the patient extubated in the operating room (YES/NO)

transfer_destination.description: Where was the patient transferred after surgery such as PACU or ICU

post_op_orders.description: What immediate post operative instructions or orders were given
